description: Meditation Boards Commission- Notice Calling for Nominations for the Appointments of Mediators- Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content deals with the appointment of mediators for special mediation boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves the Mediation Boards Commission calling for nominations for mediator positions to resolve disputes related to state and private lands, specifying eligibility criteria, nomination procedures, and selection processes. This constitutes judicial administration and dispute resolution mechanisms rather than government personnel changes, land registrations, or other specialized categories.
